name: Uehara Daisuke
source:
The only male teacher at Meiran Girls Academy, as well as the only physical educator on the staff.
His cool and sporty personality as a young man makes most of the schoolgirls think of him like their, "trusty big brother".
The real reason he is at this girls' school is because he's a pervert who lusts for the bodies of young women.
